twi.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
twi.text: Mfitiaseɛ no Onyankopɔn bɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase.

twi.en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
twi.text: Na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ hann! Na ɛyɛɛ hann.

twi.en: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
twi.text: Na adeɛ sae, na adeɛ kyee, da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne no.

twi.en: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
twi.text: Na adeɛ sae, na adeɛ kyee, da a ɛtɔ so nnan ne no.

twi.en: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
twi.text: Na adeɛ sae, na adeɛ kyee, da a ɛtɔ so nnum ne no.

twi.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
twi.text: Na wɔn baanu no deda adagya, ɔbarima no ne ne yere, nanso wɔn ani anwu.

twi.en: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
twi.text: Na ɔwɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ wuo na mobɛwuo;

twi.en: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
twi.text: Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn frɛɛ Adam, na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Wowɔ he?

fante.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
fante.text: Ahyɛse no Nyankopɔn bɔɔ sor nye asaase.

fante.en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
fante.text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Ekan mbra: na ekan bae.

fante.en: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
fante.text: Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a otsia ebiasa nye no.

fante.en: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
fante.text: Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a otsia anan nye no.

fante.en: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
fante.text: Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a otsia enum nye no.

fante.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
fante.text: Nna hɔn beenu no nyinara dzi adagyaw, banyin no nye ne yer no, naaso wɔammfɛr.

fante.en: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
fante.text: Na abowatsena no buaa ɔbaa no dɛ, Hom nnkowu bi:

fante.en: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
fante.text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn frɛɛ banyin no na obisaa no dɛ, Ewɔ hen?

ewe.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
ewe.text: Le gɔmedzedzea me la, Mawu wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba.

ewe.en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
ewe.text: Mawu gblɔ be, “Kekeli nedo.” Eye kekeli do.

ewe.en: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
ewe.text: Zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke etɔ̃lia.

ewe.en: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
ewe.text: Ale zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke enelia.

ewe.en: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
ewe.text: Eye zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke atɔ̃lia.

ewe.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
ewe.text: Togbɔ be Adam kple srɔ̃a nɔ amama hã la, ŋu mekpea wo dometɔ aɖeke o.

ewe.en: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
ewe.text: Da la gblɔ be, “Miele kuku ge akpɔ o!

ewe.en: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
ewe.text: Yehowa Mawu yɔ amea, eye wòbiae bena, “Afi ka nèle?”

ga.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
ga.text: Shishijee mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.

ga.en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
ga.text: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “La aba.” Kɛkɛ ni la ba.

ga.en: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
ga.text: Ni je na, ni je tsɛre; ni no fee gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ.

ga.en: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
ga.text: Ni je na ni je tsɛre ni no fee gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ.

ga.en: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
ga.text: Ni je na ni je tsɛre, ni efee gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ.

ga.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
ga.text: Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ, nyiɛ yayai, shi amɛhiɛ gbooo he.

ga.en: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
ga.text: Onufu lɛ kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Jeee gboimɔ nyɛaagboi;

ga.en: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
ga.text: Shi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Adam ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyɔɔ?”
